text: Matsa panel, sannan a raba shi gefe ko sama da kasa, cire shi, ko zaɓi abin da yake nunawa.

source: The layout needs a message list. Not saved yet.
text: Tsarin yana buƙatar lissafin saƙo. Ba a ajiye ba tukuna.

source: Each panel type can appear only once. Not saved yet.
text: Kowane nau'in panel zai iya bayyana sau ɗaya kawai. Ba a ajiye ba tukuna.

source: The message panel must share a split with the message list. Not saved yet.
text: Dole ne kwamitin saƙo ya raba raba tare da jerin saƙon. Ba a ajiye ba tukuna.

source: Host, host:port, or an https (or http) URL. The JMAP service is found at https://HOST[:PORT]/.well-known/jmap; the port is 443 unless given.
text: Mai watsa shiri, mai watsa shiri: tashar jiragen ruwa, ko URL (ko http). Ana samun sabis na JMAP a https://HOST[:PORT]/.well-known/jmap; tashar jiragen ruwa 443 sai dai idan an ba su.

source: Plain http: your password and mail travel unencrypted.
text: Zazzage http: kalmar sirrinku da wasiku suna tafiya ba a ɓoye ba.

source: This account cannot send: set an SMTP server or turn on Send over JMAP.
text: Wannan asusun ba zai iya aikawa: saita sabar SMTP ko kunna Aika akan JMAP ba.
